data.narrative: Capstone used the local compose fallback because Docker Desktop and any public platform were unavailable. /ready was restored with dependency checks and image_sha; a business smoke proved POST /links 200 persisted=memory and GET /r 307 while /ready stayed 503. Bounded in-memory stores and a new runbook cover the ready-green/users-failing split. Public URL, timed rollback, and git push were not done.

dimension_scores.observation: Added compose app service, IMAGE_TAG, HEALTHCHECK /live; never started a container because the engine pipe is missing.
dimension_scores.evidence: docker compose up -d --build app: open //./pipe/dockerDesktopLinuxEngine; image url-shortener:${IMAGE_TAG:-local}.

dimension_scores.observation: CI build needs lint+test and tags the git SHA; deploy is gated on vars.DEPLOY_BASE_URL so Friday main pushes do not ship.
/ready returns checks including database, cache, uptime_seconds, image_sha, in_memory_links; /metrics includes http_requests_total, duration, urls_total.
Found ready vs work-path split, unbounded RAM stores, and SHA-less process; did not invent a green public /ready.
dimension_scores.evidence: POST_LINKS 200 persisted memory while READY 503; GIT_SHA_IN_PROCESS UNSET; DEBUG_ERROR 500.

dimension_scores.observation: Breaker still fail-closes /ready; creates still persist=memory. Caps stop unbounded growth but do not make writes durable.
dimension_scores.evidence: MAX_IN_MEMORY_LINKS 10000; SMOKE still persisted=memory; /ready 200 never observed.

dimension_scores.observation: Recorded compose failure, listed env names without values, and added a runbook for ready-green user failures.

strengths: Refused to claim a public URL or a sub-2-minute rollback when Docker and Railway were absent.
Measured the inverse lie: /ready 503 while POST /links 200 persisted=memory and /r 307.
Blue-green + automated rollback reasoning named the /readyz path-drift and the hole if rollback keys only off SELECT 1.
growth_areas: No live compose deploy, so IMAGE_SHA stayed unknown and rollback was not timed.
Durable Postgres writes for POST /links were not implemented; memory SoT remains.
data.recommendation: When Docker Desktop is running, time IMAGE_TAG rollback on compose and fail /ready in production if image_sha is unknown.

public_evidence.artifact: Deploy-and-verify local fallback with readiness checks and business smoke
public_evidence.student_action: Hardened /ready JSON, gated CI deploy, bounded in-memory stores, and ran ASGI smoke plus a failed compose up.
public_evidence.technical_detail: GET /ready and /readyz; module08_deploy_smoke.py; infra/docker-compose.yml app service; ci.yml build+deploy jobs.
public_evidence.proof: SMOKE_OK True: LIVE 200, READY 503 with image_sha, POST /links 200 persisted=memory, GET /r 307. compose: Docker Desktop pipe missing.
public_evidence.ability: Treats deploy as verification with honest environment blockers, not as a pipeline checkbox.
public_evidence.reviewer_value: Shows readiness vs business-path split and SHA-tagged rollback design without fabricating a cloud URL.

concepts_demonstrated.evidence: CI deploy skipped without DEPLOY_BASE_URL; compose up failed; smoke still required.
image_sha=unknown unless IMAGE_TAG/GITHUB_SHA injected; compose DATABASE_URL overrides .env.

teaching_approaches.detail: Used already-down Postgres as the bad DATABASE_URL drill; /ready 503 with checks.database=disconnected.
